translations.web: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.
translations.bsb: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk. Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
translations.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
translations.asv: And straightway the man was made whole, and took up his bed and walked. Now it was the sabbath on that day.
